title: quarterly-rhythm-handoff-precis-and-open-issues-v0-1
body:
Executive precis (short):
This doc is a compact handoff for the next quarter cycle: draft OKRs, an all-hands framing and sample run-of-show, critical open issues that need exec decisions, and a short comms timeline. Use this as the source for the leadership sync on Feb 20 and the company town on Mar 4.

Purpose and guiding thesis:
- Align organization on a tight set of outcomes for the quarter that advance production reliability, customer-enabled growth, and cost-per-token improvement.
- Ship a clear, candid all-hands that communicates tradeoffs, how we decide what to prioritize, and concrete asks from each exec (people, time, budget).
- Surface known risks early and collect decision owners to avoid last-minute surprises.

High-level priorities for the quarter (one-liners):
1) Reliability-first: reduce P99 latency incidents and improve graceful degradation.
2) Unit economics: hit 12% lower per-token compute spend on key workloads via batching and quantization pilots.
3) Developer velocity: simplify onboarding to dedicated/private deployments, reduce time-to-first-success from 2 days -> 8 hours for reference templates.

Draft OKRs (work in progress)
Objective A — Make inference predictably reliable at scale
- KR A1: P99 request latency for 95% of production routes <= 450ms (measured week over week).
- KR A2: Incident MTTR (all severity) <= 18 minutes for infra-control-plane issues.
- KR A3: Complete canary automation for rollbacks on 3 core models (hosted + dedicated)
Owner: Joyce (SRE) / Jonah (serving-runtime)

Objective B — Reduce per-token cost for 70th percentile workloads
- KR B1: Implement prefix caching baseline in prod for two high-volume customers and measure 10% unit savings.
- KR B2: Ship quantization recommendation engine with 3 model profiles recommended per workload type.
- KR B3: Reduce average GPU token runtime by 8% via kernel selection improvements.
Owner: Marco (optimize) / Engineering performance leads

Objective C — Make Dedicated & Private drastically easier to adopt
- KR C1: Cut setup time for Dedicated POC from average 6 wks -> 2 wks (telemetry baseline INF-ops/POC).
- KR C2: 80% of onboarding bugs triaged within 48 hours; produce a 1-pager for legal/compliance checklist.
Owner: Priya (solutions-eng) / Aisha (private-deploys)

Notes on OKRs: these are intentionally narrow. We will workshop KR thresholds at leadership sync. If a KR depends on external vendor/partner (cloud partner or HW supplier), mark as dependency and schedule biweekly check-ins.

All-hands plan (draft):
- Date: Mar 4, 09:30 PT (tentative)
- Duration: 60 min (+ optional breakouts)
- Theme: "Operational Confidence & Unit Economics" (one-sentence: where we were, how we fix it, what we need from the org)
- Core segments (timings):
  0–5 min: Welcome, framing, housekeeping (CEO)
  5–20 min: State of the product & performance (CPO + short dashboard)
  20–35 min: Customer stories + quick demo of Dedicated onboarding improvements (Customer Success + Solutions Eng)
  35–45 min: OKR highlight & what success looks like this quarter (Exec leads)
  45–55 min: Exec asks and decision checkpoints (panel)
  55–60 min: Closing + immediate action items (People Ops/comms)
- Prep checklist (owner):
  - Data dashboard snapshot (observability) — Jonah — due Feb 24
  - One-slide customer success story + permission to share — Priya — due Feb 26
  - Speaker scripts + time allocations — Leah — due Feb 28
  - Rehearsal (tech + transitions) — Mar 3 10:00 PT — ops/AV

Comms timeline (short):
- Feb 20: Leadership sync to finalize OKRs + exec asks
- Feb 21: Draft all-hands slides distributed to execs for comment
- Feb 26: Final slides + rehearsal RSVP
- Mar 1: Town invite + FAQs posted to #announcements
- Mar 4: All-hands (live)

Decision points & open issues (items that require exec input now):
1) Budget reallocation for Dedicated capacity trials (ask: approval to reallocate up to $75k from experimentation budget) — Owner: Finance + Head of Product. Decision needed by Feb 25.
2) SLA promise language for next quarter marketing materials. Legal wants stricter wording; marketing needs friendly comms. Align on template by Feb 22.
3) Hiring: we need one senior infra engineer + one SRE headcount to meet KR A2. Can we approve hiring requisition this cycle? (Hiring team already prioritized, req INF-HR-89)
4) Customer beta access policy: enable early private deployments for two strategic accounts under NDA. Decision: list of accounts and legal signoff required by Mar 1.

Risks and mitigations (short):
- Risk: Kernel/quantization pilot produces quality regressions for long-sequence prompts.
  Mitigation: hold internal eval set + automated regression alerts; roll out behind feature flag.
- Risk: Dedicated onboarding delays due to networking approvals in customer VPCs.
  Mitigation: create a standard set of templates for common cloud providers and a preflight checklist for customers.
- Risk: Comms fatigue if we change OKRs mid-quarter.
  Mitigation: limit mid-quarter revisions to emergency pivots only; use change log and an explicit approval flow.

Metrics dashboard (what we'll show at leadership sync):
- P50/P95/P99 latency (by route and model)
- Cost per token (by model family) and delta vs baseline
- Time-to-first-success: average days to get Dedicated POC running
- MTTR and incident counts by service area

Immediate asks for execs (short bullets to include in the panel):
- Finance: provisional sign-off on Dedicated trial budget (owner: Marco, due Feb 25)
- Legal: finalize SLA language and beta NDAs (owner: Priya, due Feb 22)
- People: expedite req for senior infra hire (owner: Leah, due Feb 28)
- Product: confirm top 3 models for quantization pilot (owner: Marco, due Feb 21)

Open issues backlog (quick list, to triage after leadership sync):
- INF-3001: telemetry gaps for KV cache hit rates (notes: partial data from prod clusters, needs agent update)
- INF-3022: rollout automation flaky on region failover tests
- OPS-119: onboarding doc contradictions for private deployments

Next steps & ownership (actionable):
- Leadership sync Feb 20: finalize OKR thresholds and exec asks (Owner: Leah)
- Update this doc with final OKRs and publish to Confluence (Owner: Leah)
- All-hands slides + rehearsals (Owner: Leah + AV ops)
- Create Issues in JIRA for the top 6 open risks and tag owners (Owner: Jonah)

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep slides short: each exec gets 2–3 slides max. Avoid deep technical walk-throughs — use breakouts for that.
- Remember to ask for small, concrete asks (budget/OKR sign-off/hire) during the panel — not vague commitments.
- Follow up doc: 1 pager to distro after all-hands with clear next steps + owners.

End of precis.

Feedback loop: add comments directly to this Drive doc or ping @leah.kim in #leadership-sync.
